title: Software Engineer Intern - Berlin (2027)
descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


Why Join Us? What We Offer

We cultivate an inclusive, welcoming, and empowering environment where every intern is set up for success from day one:

  • Dedicated Mentorship & Support: High level of access to your manager and a personal mentor who provide guidance, constructive feedback, and continuous support without micromanagement.

  • Real Impact & Ownership: Work alongside world-class experts on meaningful, real-world projects that contribute directly to systems used by global customers.

  • Inclusive Culture & Flexibility: Work in a vibrant team with flexible working hours, work-from-home options, casual dress code, and an inclusive, community-focused startup culture.

  • Career Growth: Clear pathways for post-internship career opportunities, including full-time roles and additional internship options.

  • Perks & Community: Paid full-time internship, catered lunches, team outings, happy hours, access to gaming consoles, recreational games, employee resource groups, and great swag.

What You Will Learn & Gain

  • How to build enterprise-grade, reliable, and secure cloud software and services.

  • Hands-on experience with cutting-edge database internals, large-scale distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

  • Practical knowledge in compiler design, query execution, streaming pipelines, and advanced SQL features.

  • Colleague mentorship and collaborative problem-solving experience in a modern tech stack (C++, Java).


What We Are Looking For

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education: Must be actively enrolled in an accredited college or university program during the time of the internship (from 3rd year Bachelor up to Master’s or PhD levels) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Physics, Math, or a related technical field.

  • Duration: 4 month minimum, 6 months recommended, up to 12 months supported, start date flexible

  • Target start dates: February 2027 and onward

  • Foundational knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and operating systems.

  • Programming experience in C++ or Java, and familiarity with systems programming concepts (e.g., multi-threading, concurrency).

  • Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment and solve problems creatively.

  • Fluent written and spoken English skills.

Bonus Skills (Nice to Have, Not Required):

  • Coursework or familiarity with database systems, distributed systems, cloud computing, or compilers.

  • Experience or interest in big data engineering, data processing, or geospatial features.

  • Contributions to open-source projects, research experience, or publications in databases/distributed systems.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
